title: Hundreds march against planned ICE detention centre in San Antonio
seoTitle: San Antonio march against ICE detention centre

tea.why: ICE bought a warehouse on Southeast Loop 410 in February and plans to turn it into a detention centre for up to 1,500 people.
tea.want: Stop the planned detention centre on the East Side.
tea.changed: Oct 3: hundreds walked more than a mile from S.J. Davis Middle School to the warehouse site.

summary: Hundreds of people marched on San Antonio's East Side on the morning of October 3 against a proposed U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention centre. ICE bought a warehouse on Southeast Loop 410 in February and plans to use it to hold up to 1,500 detainees. The 'March for Freedom and Justice', organised by the San Antonio Freedom Coalition, set off near S.J. Davis Middle School and walked to the warehouse. Speakers included U.S. Representative Joaquin Castro, Bexar County Commissioner Tommy Calvert and a local Catholic priest. Some local officials say the facility could harm nearby residents, infrastructure and the environment.
demands: Stop the planned ICE detention centre
response: No response from ICE or federal officials is reported in the sources; some local officials oppose the facility.

updates.text: Hundreds marched from S.J. Davis Middle School to the warehouse ICE bought in February.
